description: This bar chart illustrates the GLUE performance for different fine-tuning methods using two RoBERTa model sizes. The horizontal axis represents the fine-tuning method, labeled as Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₂-model, and S₅-model, presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “GLUE Performance,” ranges from approximately 84 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 2, and represents a linear scale. Two bars are present for each fine-tuning method, representing “base” and “large” RoBERTa sizes, colored light blue and orange, respectively. For the Adaptor method, the “base” model achieves a performance of approximately 85, while the “large” model reaches approximately 87. For LoRA, the “base” model has a performance of approximately 86, and the “large” model reaches approximately 88. BitFit shows a “base” model performance of approximately 86 and a “large” model performance of approximately 87. The S₁-model has a “base” performance of approximately 84 and a “large” performance of approximately 86. The S₂-model has a “base” performance of approximately 86 and a “large” performance of approximately 88. Finally, the S₅-model has a “base” performance of approximately 87 and a “large” performance of approximately 90. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each fine-tuning method, with the “base” model bar appearing to the left of the “large” model bar. No bars are visually emphasized.
